aum.quote: ZAKA VC Fund I sized €15M is now starting with a €10.5M first closing in June 2024 with a minimum LP ticket of €130k.

investments.quote: ZAKA VC first invested in Sygaldry through Fund I in June 2025, shortly after the company emerged from the Y Combinator Spring 2025 batch, and also participated in the Series A round announced this month

Prague-based Readmio, which develops interactive children’s story apps with sound and learning features, has secured €1 million in new funding from Simpact Ventures, with support from ZAKA VC, Zero One Hundred, and DEPO Ventures, as Vestbee was informed.
ZAKA VC has invested in Cirrus Therapeutics, a biotechnology company developing next-generation gene therapies for chronic blinding eye diseases, including age-related macular degeneration (AMD).

notes: Czech-Slovak family office (Kasper and Zálešák families) turned VC; offices in Silicon Valley, London, Prague and Bratislava, HQ given as Prague in tech.eu. AUM is Fund I target (EUR 15M, 2024); the homepage now shows a 17M current fund size without a clean quotable sentence. Recent deals are mostly US/UK; Slovak link e.g. Sensible Biotechnologies (pre-seed 2022).
